## Payment Method

 payment.gts ships the rail enum (card / bank transfer / cash / other); this Spec registers it and names its second consumer: PaymentTermsField carries it as the vendor’s preferred rail, alongside Payment’s original use on the transaction itself.

### Example

A primitive enum cannot carry containedExamples — see the linked Payment Terms on Acme Supply’s profile (rail: bank transfer).

### Non-goals

No rail-specific detail fields here (IBAN/routing live on remit-to/bank blocks). Widening the rail list is the owning module’s change.
